full_description: DESI TV USA is the only Live TV channel and emerging communication platform, which offers 24x7 hours a day live transmission, for the South Asian & Middle Eastern communities that are residing in Houston & Texas areas. DESI TV USA represents not only Indian, Pakistani, Arabic, Bangali, Nepali and other South Asian and Middle Eastern countries, but it also represents local Houston metro area's communities and their current popular events. DESI TV USA covers all important activities that help in promoting alliances between cultures and societies. DESI TV USA is the leader channel that remains on the forefront of increasing trades and businesses in between ethnic groups. From entertainment, news, politics, sports, to business, DESI TV USA Live covers them all. You can watch DESI TV USA Live and Video-On-Demand on ANDROID, IPHONE, ROKU, WEB, JADOO, SHAVA, DESI IPTV, SOOPER, BOL, BTV, CROWN, LiveStream, Youtube, DailyMotion, TV Set-top Boxes, Satellite channels (tbd) and many other connected platforms.
